description.value: Subway Peachtree Square is a franchise sandwich shop in Penticton's Peachtree Square retail area on Skaha Lake Road, near the southern end of the city close to Skaha Lake. It offers made-to-order Footlongs, wraps, salads, and breakfast items, with in-restaurant dining, curbside pickup, and delivery all available. The independently owned and operated location is a practical food stop for cyclists traveling the Skaha Lake corridor.
